query:
SELECT library_files.path, library_files.library_id,
                              library_items.kind AS "kind: ItemKind",
                              library_items.season, library_items.episode, (SELECT json_group_object(namespace, value) FROM item_match_ids
              WHERE item_match_ids.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND scope = IIF(library_items.kind = 'movie', 'title', 'show')) AS "ids?: String"
                       FROM library_files
                       JOIN library_items ON library_items.file_id = library_files.id
                       LEFT JOIN item_matches ON item_matches.item_id = library_items.id
                                             AND item_matches.state = 'matched'
                       WHERE library_files.id = ?
                       ORDER BY library_items.season, library_items.episode, library_items.id
                       LIMIT 1
